explanation: A₁(N) is the number of maximal Sidon subsets of [1,N] (IsMaximalSidonSetIn: Sidon, and no further element of [1,N] can be added), as on erdosproblems.com/862. Question: is A₁(N) > 2^{N^c} for some c > 0? Yes, by the same argument. The statement gives c > 0 with 2^{N^c} < A₁(N) eventually. Faithful.
